Ryan: Context is the bill is a techniques catalog, not a slogan. Filed stories/ANTH-c28002/context-techniques.md — new thread, don’t paste, thin rules, MCP off, no log dumps, don’t switch mid-chat, two strikes then clear, pin children. Steal from Anthropic/Continuum/Burns/Tokenminning.

All context techniques stay in the draft. Sub-agent research for technique 1: child usually does not inherit parent chat; parent writes a brief. Child often still loads rules and inherits MCP. Claude fork is the junk-drawer opt-in. Sub-agents complementary to /clear, not a replacement. subagent-context.md

Ryan: technique 1 architecture is manager = long thread (compact separately); each worker = fresh context with only the brief. Not competing with /clear. Standing MCP/rules on children are a settings caveat. Recorded in subagent-context.md and context-techniques.md.

Sub-agent thrift: isolation saves because workers don’t re-bill the manager junk drawer. Parallelism multiplies windows. Then Jevons — cheaper tasks, more tasks, total can rise. One beat, link ecc2ae. File: subagent-savings.md
